name: Air Traffic Controller
title: Air Traffic Controller (AAI JE-ATC)
intro: From Class 12 PCM to an AAI air traffic controller: a degree with Physics and Maths, the AAI Junior Executive (ATC) online exam, a voice test, medical and background checks, then training and an ATC licence.

phases.title: Class 12 with Physics and Maths
phases.summary: PCM keeps both eligible degree routes open.
points: The degree AAI asks for must include Physics and Mathematics, so Class 12 Science (PCM) is the natural route.
Commerce and Arts students are not eligible, because the degree needs both subjects.
Start working on clear spoken and written English — AAI tests it later.

phases.title: Earn an eligible degree
phases.summary: A full-time B.Sc with Physics and Maths, or a full-time B.E./B.Tech in any discipline.
points: Option 1: a full-time 3-year B.Sc with Physics and Mathematics.
Option 2: a full-time B.E./B.Tech in any discipline, with Physics and Mathematics in any semester.
A B.Sc Chemistry counts only if Physics and Mathematics are also subjects in it.

phases.title: AAI JE (ATC) online exam
phases.summary: A computer-based test with general aptitude, English and technical (Physics & Maths) parts.
points: AAI recruits through its own online exam — GATE is not needed.
The test has general aptitude, English and technical (Physics & Maths) sections; the notification states which part decides merit.
Age limits and relaxations are set in the current AAI recruitment notice.

phases.title: Voice test, medical and checks
phases.summary: Clear speech for radio work, then medical, psychoactive substance test, psychological assessment and background check.
points: The voice test checks clear, confident speech and English — essential for radio communication.
Documents are verified after the voice test.
Medical fitness, a psychoactive substance test, a psychological assessment and a background check follow, to AAI standards.

phases.title: Training, licence and career
phases.summary: AAI training, an ATC licence and ratings for each control unit, then posting.
points: After AAI training, controllers are licensed and rated for each control unit they work.
Pay: the E-1 scale of ₹40,000–1,40,000 stated in AAI notices, plus DA, HRA/perks and allowances, with PSU medical, leave and retirement benefits.
Growth path: Junior Executive → Manager → Senior Manager → AGM → DGM → GM (ATM).
